title: Fixed Slotted Shovel Pan and Raised Loop Handle
description: One newly authored complete empty static litter-scoop-inspired hand tool. A wide low shovel pan has a genuine through-slotted floor, two full low side walls and a full rear wall while the front remains open behind a finite blunt entry lip. Seven long enclosed apertures pass through the entire floor, with shared solid rails connected to the complete front and rear floor strips. One rising rear neck carries a complete elongated open loop grip behind the pan rather than across its cavity. The grip has a true through-opening and finite shell thickness, not a painted inset. All new numeric geometry; no old meshes or parts imported. Not the existing front-tooth berry comb with over-cavity arch, and not the hooded long upright pole dustpan with pivot fork. Three constant opaque PBR roles, metre Z up and whole horizontal bounds-centred ground origin. One original model zero scenes. Empty static artwork only: no waste, litter or food, sifting efficiency, cleaning instructions, animal suitability, hygiene, ergonomics, strength, manufacture or use safety capability. No rigging, animation or interaction.
